integrity: Proof is self-contained for this graph family; exact finite state enumeration is corroboration and is not an infinite certificate. New claim has self-review only.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to switchings of one-negative-edge signings on complete bipartite graphs with both parts of order at least three. Does not classify thinner bicliques, other switching classes, or signed-burning time. Unindexed prior results remain possible.
title: Burning codes and the balance jump for one-frustration bicliques
